_comment: Defaults for POST /api/run. Reloaded on every run, so values can be tuned without restarting the server.
Each stage: 'script' (path relative to open_vocab_3d/) or 'cmd' (full argv prefix; '{python}' = the server's interpreter), plus 'args' mapped generically to CLI flags:
true -> '--flag'; false/null -> omitted; list -> '--flag=a,b'; anything else -> '--flag=value'.
The server injects the I/O flags itself: render --usd/--out, detect --renders/--out/--prompts, lift --renders/--detections/--out.
lift '--save-ply': true is replaced by the run dir's clusters.ply path.
POST /api/run body overrides: prompts -> detect --prompts, num_views -> render --num-views, mode -> render --mode.
config._notes: R&D tuning 2026-10-07 for room_scan.usda (5 target classes), validated by projecting the 3D boxes back onto renders. RENDER: dome at --radius-scale 0.4 (was 0.6) makes the booth fill the frame; the ~25-40 cm plates go from a median 41-63 px to 59-91 px and the detector stops preferring whole-structure boxes. 40 views gives each plate ~19 visible views; 30 or 48 views and seeds 0/1/2 gave the same 8 objects. Interior and dome+interior ('--mode both', now supported) were worse: close-ups mostly yield full-frame turf/wall boxes that bridge clusters. DETECT: --text-threshold 0.35 (was 0.25) stops Grounding DINO from emitting merged phrases such as 'plywood panel artificial turf' that boxed whole walls. The user's prompt strings are kept: rephrasing ('round decorative plate', 'green artificial turf', 'plywood board') was not better, and 'wooden cabinet' only boxed the whole 2 m booth. LIFT: --min-score 0.35, window 0.4 (low-score window boxes cover the white wall under the window and doubled its height). --max-extent-per-class drops single detections and clusters too large for the class (a decorative plate is under 0.5 m), which removes whole-booth boxes. --det-cluster-classes groups plates by per-detection 3D centroids, because the three plates touch on the wall and point-DBSCAN merges them into one 0.6 m blob. --min-views 3 adds margin; every true object has 4+ views. Expected result: 1 window, 2 plywood panel, 2 artificial turf, 3 decorative plate, 0 cabinet.
